text:
You saw dry fields accuse clouds and rain; then furrows fear watering threatening lightning.


They prefer dryness to burning, seeing fire accompany water, lightning, and thunder.


So my eyes fear beauty coveted in yours, longing for pure light.


As they opened, they struck lightning and set aflame in me all they saw.

translation.title: As the Farmer Fears Rain with Thunder, So Is His Shepherdess's Gaze
